description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), damages the user for 99% current HP, grants [Attach Lightning], [Awoken Lightning], [Damage Cap +10000], [Stoneskin: 100%], [Once in a Lifetime Mode] and [Brave Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Lightning
description.text: Lightning abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Lightning abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Stoneskin: 100%
description.text: Reduces damage taken to 0, up to an amount equal to 100% of the character's maximum HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Once in a Lifetime Mode
description.text: Critical chance =100%, removed if the character doesn't have any Stoneskin
